newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines says ADB loans well-utilised.
newsitem.headline: Philippines says ADB loans well-utilised.

text.p: The Philippines said on Friday loans granted by the Asian Development Bank (ADB) had been well-utilised in the first six months of the year.

"Disbursements for ADB project loans went up by 149.27 percent while ongoing projects showed remarkable progress in actual implementation," the Coordinating Council of the Philippine Assistance Programme (CCPAP) said in a statement. CCPAP is the monitoring agency for the utilisation of foreign loans.
CCPAP said the Philippines drew down $245.09 million from $98.32 million last year.
CCPAP executive director Francisco del Rosario said problems which plagued some ADB-financed projects haD been resolved.
In the past, ADB had complained about delays in the drawdown of loans.
